summary: Danaos Corporation filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, providing proxy materials for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders scheduled for July 31, 2026. The agenda includes electing two Class II directors and ratifying the appointment of independent auditors. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change—is announced. The filing is a routine current report on Form 6-K (the foreign private issuer equivalent of a U.S. domestic proxy filing) and does not contain any transaction or corporate action that would qualify as a special situation.
